payout_quote: Open and fund a new Premium Savings Account by 1/10/2027. Use promo code: SAVE800. You'll earn a cash bonus when you deposit at least $20,000 of qualifying new money within the first 30 days of account opening. Maintain your balance for 45 additional days after the 30-day funding period ends to earn your cash bonus. Deposit Amount / Cash Bonus: $20,000 - $99,999 -> $400 | $100,000 or more -> $800. Award-winning high-yield savings: market-leading APY, no minimum deposit, no monthly account fees. (Official E*TRADE promo page, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Bonus earned after the 30-day funding period plus the 45-day maintenance period; the page does not state the exact credit date
eligibility: New Premium Savings Account customers (IRA and brokerage ineligible); U.S. residents; lifetime limit of two PSA bonus offers per customer; open by 1/10/2027 with promo code SAVE800
steps: Open a new Premium Savings Account on etrade.com by January 10, 2027 using promo code SAVE800

catches: Requires $20,000+ of qualifying new money - only works if you already have this much liquid cash to move
New money only - funds already at E*TRADE/Morgan Stanley affiliates do not count
Money must stay parked for ~75 days total to earn the bonus
One PSA bonus offer at a time; lifetime maximum of two PSA bonuses per customer
Must apply promo code SAVE800 at account opening - single use

biggest_catch: This only works if you have $20,000+ in cash you can park for 75 days - it's a bonus on money you already have, not money from nothing. Do not borrow or invest money you can't afford to lock up to chase this.
